data.title: Stryker CEO Kevin Lobo says robots now do 2 of every 3 knee replacements—and he won’t build them in China because ‘the IP is a massive worry’ | Fortune
data.description: Kevin Lobo told Fortune that Chinese companies are “knocking off a lot of the other robots” as Stryker bets $400 million on a soft-tissue surgical robot.
data.author: Nick Lichtenberg
